Edifoligide was dosed in over 2,000 human participants (PREVENT III and PREVENT IV vein-graft trials), so it is a high-exposure clinically dosed construct, and double-stranded PS decoys are exactly the architecture where per-strand chemistry is usually missing from the literature. Rare case where a vocabulary record is more complete than most primary publications.

title: Phase 1b randomized study of antidote-controlled modulation of factor IXa activity in patients with stable coronary artery disease
authors_year: Chan MY, Cohen MG, Dyke CK, Myles SK, Aberle LG, Lin M, Walder J, Steinhubl SR, Gilchrist IC, Kleiman NS, Vorchheimer DA, Chronos N, Melloni C, Alexander JH, Harrington RA, Tonkens RM, Becker RC, Rusconi CP — Circulation 2008;117(22):2865-74
species_and_system: Human in vivo, interventional. 50 human participants with stable CAD on aspirin and/or clopidogrel; randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; 4 dose levels of RB006 (pegnivacogin, PEGylated anti-FIXa RNA aptamer) at 15/30/50/75 mg IV bolus with RB007 complementary-oligonucleotide antidote at 30/60/100/150 mg.
why_relevant: The one genuinely valuable study record CTD surfaced, and the only oligo-coagulopathy record in the whole database with curated DirectEvidence. CTD links RB 006 to Hematoma (MESH:D006406, marker/mechanism) and to a human F9 chem-gene row ('RB 007 inhibits the reaction [RB 006 binds to and results in decreased activity of F9]'). The paper itself is a human interventional trial whose PRIMARY pharmacodynamic endpoint is aPTT: the abstract alone prints dose-level medians with 25th/75th percentiles at 10 min post-bolus — 29.2 s (28.1, 29.8), 34.6 s (30.9, 40.0), 46.9 s (40.3, 51.1), 52.2 s (46.3, 58.6), P<0.0001 — plus antidote reversal, so usable numeric coagulation endpoints are extractable even without full text. Also an oligo CLASS not well represented by ASO/siRNA data: an aptamer whose anticoagulation is on-target FIXa inhibition rather than PS contact activation, which makes it a useful mechanistic contrast. Note it is a different construct from the three other REG1 publications, so check for overlap before adding.

title: Thymidine-phosphorothioate oligonucleotides induce activation and apoptosis of CLL cells independently of CpG motifs or BCL-2 gene interference
authors_year: Castro JE, Prada CE, Aguillon RA, Kitada S, Fukuda T, Motta M, Wu C, Dicker F, Sun G, Wang JY, Carson DA, Reed JC, Kipps TJ — Leukemia 2006;20(4):680-8
species_and_system: Human ex vivo primary cells in vitro: primary chronic lymphocytic leukemia B cells from patients, treated with matched phosphorothioate (PS-ODN) versus phosphodiester (PO-ODN) oligonucleotides including G3139/oblimersen.
why_relevant: Not a coagulation assay, so it closes no coagulation gap — included because it is the single cleanest BACKBONE-ATTRIBUTION control in CTD's oligo curation and is directly reusable as methodological support. It is a human primary-cell experiment that isolates the phosphorothioate backbone itself as the causal agent: effects occurred with PS-ODN but not sequence-matched PO-ODN, and were independent of both the antisense sequence and CpG motifs. That is the same backbone-versus-sequence logic needed to attribute aPTT prolongation to the PS backbone rather than to target knockdown, in the same species and with a donor-derived human system. Cited by CTD as the source for its Phosphorothioate Oligonucleotides (D054735) chem-gene rows on BAX, BCL2, BID and TP53.

identifier: CTD curation error — chemical MESH:C519562 (imetelstat) x disease MESH:D013923 (Thromboembolism), cited to PMID 21559248
title: DO NOT INGEST: CTD attributes thromboembolism and VEGFR/KIT binding to imetelstat on the strength of a paper that is actually about motesanib
authors_year: CTD release 2026-09-29; cited source is Burris H, Stephenson J, Otterson GA, Stein M, McGreivy J, Sun YN, Ingram M, Ye Y, Schwartzberg LS — J Oncol 2011;2011:853931
species_and_system: Human interventional phase 1b, 41 patients with advanced solid tumours — but the agent is motesanib (an oral small-molecule VEGFR1/2/3, PDGFR and KIT antagonist) with panitumumab plus gemcitabine-cisplatin, NOT imetelstat.
why_relevant: Reported as a data-quality warning, not as evidence. On its face this is the most attractive oligo-coagulopathy hit in CTD: imetelstat is a thio-phosphoramidate oligonucleotide, it causes clinically important thrombocytopenia, and this is CTD's only curated DirectEvidence 'marker/mechanism' link from an oligo to Thromboembolism. Verification by E-utilities shows the cited paper never studies imetelstat — the 10 venous and 3 arterial thromboembolic events were motesanib-related, and the FLT1/FLT4/KDR/KIT binding rows CTD assigns to imetelstat are motesanib's pharmacology. Almost certainly a motesanib/imetelstat name-collision error in curation. If any pipeline ingests CTD DirectEvidence automatically, this row would inject a false oligo-thromboembolism association with a human trial attached; it should be excluded by name and, if useful, reported upstream to CTD.

title: Predicting antisense oligonucleotide-mediated toxicity using three-dimensional liver microtissue models (analysis code)
authors_year: Roy J, Amniouel S, Filippi BGH, Sanchez K, Grassano M, Farkhondeh A, Traynor B; record dated 2027/2028 in Zenodo metadata
species_and_system: Human 3D liver microtissues (in vitro) compared against mouse liver in vivo data; LNA-modified ASOs

title: Data from: Formulation and toxicology evaluation of the intrathecal AYX1 DNA-decoy in Sprague Dawley rats (Mamet et al., Toxicological Sciences 2017)
authors_year: Mamet et al., 2017
species_and_system: Rat (Sprague Dawley), in vivo GLP and non-GLP toxicology; plus cell-free formulation stability testing of the drug substance
why_relevant: The ONLY oligonucleotide toxicology dataset in Dryad. AYX1 (brivoligide) is a 23-base-pair double-stranded UNMODIFIED (the abstract says 'unprotected') DNA EGR1 decoy that was subsequently dosed in human participants, so its per-position chemistry is fully determined by that description. Two of the ten deposited files are drug-substance characterisation: Supplemental Table 1 (stability of the AYX1:calcium formulation in sodium phosphate vs Tris buffer at 2 weeks) and Supplemental Table 2 (stability in Tris buffer at 3 months) — i.e. tested-material stability/integrity data of exactly the kind Phase 2 asks for under purity and characterisation. Supplemental Tables 3 and 8 are full clinical laboratory assessments of dosed rats (Day 3/30 in study ADY-TX2; Day 14 in ADY-SNITX1); GLP clinical pathology panels of this type routinely carry platelet count and coagulation times, but I could NOT confirm which analytes are present because the file payloads are blocked (see barrier). Supplemental protocol information likely carries the decoy sequence. Deposit is CC0. Caveat: rat only — there is no human system here, so it does NOT close gap 1 or gap 2, and its coagulation content is unverified
